prompt: Panda character design: Body widest at bottom, narrowing upward, width to height ratio 1:1.15, occupying 60% of total area. Round head, almost no neck, directly connected to body, 25% of total area. Short limbs; hands ~20% of body length. Extremely infantile, minimalist facial features: small glass bead eyes, black oval whiskers slightly downward, small black triangular nose, weakened mouth, slight blush. All contours are round no sharp corners, straight lines, or aggression. Ears, shoulders, hands, and eye circles are black; rest is white. Drawn with graphite pencil, fine cross hatching, delicate hand drawn texture, retro children's picture book style, black and white, large blank space, simple composition, subtle visual humor, warm, quiet, healing atmosphere. --ar 3:4 --v 8.1
